violations.text: Pork, tofu, and chicken were observed held between 98-125 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Various items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The presence of roaches are not controlled as evidenced by live roach. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. PIC obtained the incorrect test strips. Inspector provided. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - sides/in-between equipment - prep units - prep tables/shelves - refrigerators Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Raw animal foods (such as chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as soup) in the refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC reorganized unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener and ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Beef, chicken, fish, and soup were observed held between 92-08 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Rice, sprouts, chicken, fried sweet potato were observed held between 72-84 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed items in refrigerator for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Various items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview with PIC, chicken/beef broth is placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. PIC informed to split containers up for active cooling. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by large rodent droppings in storage/mop sink closet. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026
